By the time of the [[Third Galactic War]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|7.0}}</ref> '''Ri'kan's Vibro-Axe''' was a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-axe]] utilized by [[Ri'kan Kateen]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served as a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] of the [[Hidden Chain]]. The vibro-axe conducted an open electric current that could be either [[Color|yellow]] or blue in coloration.<ref name="CM" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]]<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> weapon debuted within the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]], announced on [[December 13]], [[2022]].<ref name="CM" />
